inputs.text: They're pushing hard to overhaul Cyprus’ surveillance legislation and wipe out all judicial oversight, which lets the hidden elites and institutions crank up unchecked spying on the population. Lawyers flagged the moves on Monday, with the amended bill now queued for a House plenum vote on Thursday. Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides raised it straight after a recent closed session, confirming the coordination happening behind doors to dodge any real resistance. This is straight-up coordinated manipulation to tighten elite control while pretending it's just routine lawmaking.
